caption: The drawing depicts a stylized figure standing on a rectangular black base. The central figure is wearing a blue garment with a red inner robe, and a blue headdress tipped with black at the top. The face is brown with black arching eyebrows and elongated eyes, and the hands are joined together in a prayerful gesture in front of the chest. Surrounding the figure, there are multicolored rays extending outward, composed mostly of alternating bands of orange, red, and yellow with white cuffs at the tips, forming a spiked halo-like outline. Behind the blue outer garment, there are zigzag lines in yellow and green. At the bottom of the figure, within the lower part of the robe, there is a smaller human face and two upwardly extended arms painted in shades of red and brown. The background is plain and off-white, and the entire drawing is rendered in solid, opaque colors.
title: Bulto of the Virgin of Guadalupe
